eltonylfgi-blip-claude-session-triage-tr.description: Scan every local Claude Code session (across all projects on this machine), find the ones idle long enough to count as abandoned, extract what each was waiting on, and report a single triage panel. Use when the user asks "what did I leave open", "what's pending across my chats", "session triage", "what was I doing", or opens this after a break with several parallel Claude Code sessions.
